data.body: [P1] Prevent late change hooks from superseding the final snapshot. `ExecutionManager` invokes this hook before shutdown waits for unobserved asynchronous operations, so a checkpoint thread can still call `onOperationChange` while this method drains. Because the state remains active, that `RUNNING` record can replace the pending terminal record or be exported afterward, leaving sinks such as S3 with `RUNNING` for a completed execution. Atomically mark the per-ARN state closed before scheduling the end record and reject subsequent change hooks; add coverage for an unawaited async operation completing during invocation end.
